about.title: About App
about.githubMirrorHint: *Go to Settings - Network Proxy to enable the GitHub mirror to speed up updates
about.cnbChannelHint: *The CNB channel only provides release builds

advanced.title: Advanced Options
advanced.autoSetChineseLanguageHint: *Automatically switch the game language to Simplified Chinese when the game starts
advanced.gameOverlayHint: *Press Shift+Tab in-game to show or hide the overlay
advanced.gameFullscreenHint: *Opens the game window in fullscreen mode by default after launching; when enabled, the window size is no longer passed
advanced.beforeLaunchCommandHint: Leave empty by default; runs and waits for completion before the game starts
advanced.afterLaunchCommandHint: Leave empty by default; runs in the background after the game process is created
advanced.launchCommandPlaceholder: Leave empty by default, e.g. cmd /c {command}
advanced.keepUnchanged: Keep unchanged after the game launches
advanced.exitLauncher: Exit the launcher after the game launches
advanced.hideAndRestore: Hide after the game launches, restore when the game exits
advanced.minimizeAndRestore: Minimize after the game launches, restore when the game exits

agent.title: Network Proxy
agent.prefixProxyMode: Prefix Proxy - prepend the mirror site to the original address
agent.directAccessMode: Direct Access - replace the domain with the mirror site
agent.prefixProxyModeHint: *Prefix proxy mode: fill in the mirror site address, e.g. https://ghfast.top or ghproxy.net
agent.directAccessModeHint: *Direct access mode: fill in the mirror site domain, e.g. bgithub.xyz
agent.disableSystemProxyHint: *When enabled alone, all network requests connect directly without using the system proxy
agent.proxyUrlPlaceholder: *Both modes accept the {url} placeholder for the original download URL, e.g. https://example.com/?q={url}

applicationdebug.title: Other Settings
applicationdebug.portalProtocolHint: *After registration, the launcher can be invoked from a browser via the protocol
applicationdebug.debugModeHint: *Shows application startup and runtime logs; requires restarting the program to take effect.

download.title: Download Settings
download.highConcurrencyWarning: Too much concurrency can cause lag

java.title: Java Runtime
java.autoCleanMemoryBeforeLaunch: Automatically clean memory before the game launches
java.autoCleanMemoryBeforeLaunchHint: Requests administrator privileges to clean memory when the game launches; a UAC prompt may appear.
java.autoHighPerformanceGpu: Automatically use the high-performance GPU for Java
java.autoHighPerformanceGpuHint: Automatically selects the high-performance discrete GPU for Java when launching the game

notification.title: Notification Options
notification.showMinecraftNews: Show Minecraft News on the New Tab Page
notification.showRecentPlays: Show Recent Games on the New Tab Page

shortcuts.title: Key Bindings
shortcuts.searchPlaceholder: Search action names or shortcuts, e.g. Toggle Theme, Ctrl+Shift+Q
shortcuts.shortcutHint: Press Esc to clear the current shortcut. A combination must include at least one modifier key (Ctrl / Shift / Alt / Win)
shortcuts.resetToDefaultHint: Reset to the default shortcut for this action
